name: emoji-picker-popover
title: Emoji Picker Popover
description: The emoji picker in a non-modal Floating UI popover, for any shadcn/ui base: EmojiPickerPopover, and EmojiPickerPopoverContent composing EmojiPopover's Portal, Positioner and Popup. A pick closes it. For a modal React Aria popover, use emoji-picker-popover-aria.
